title: apps/dashvalidator: request/response shape duplicated by hand; panics are intentional
answers: What breaks if I add a field to dashvalidator's check request/response?
How do I add a new datasource type to dashvalidator?
body:
The `check` route's request/response shape has NO codegen tying it together (unlike the dead `DashboardCompatibilityScore` CUE kind, which does have CUE→Go/TS gen via `make gen-cue` but is unused — `app.go:GetKinds` returns empty). It is hand-duplicated in three places that must be edited together when a field changes: `apps/dashvalidator/kinds/manifest.cue` (`routes.namespaced."/check"`), the `checkRequest`/`checkResponse`/`datasourceResult`/`queryResult` structs in `apps/dashvalidator/pkg/app/app.go`, and the TS interfaces in `public/.../compatibilityApi.ts`. Internal types `validator.QueryResult`/`validator.DatasourceValidationResult` are separate from the wire structs and bridged only by `app.go:convertToCheckResponse`.

Score scale differs by layer: Go's `CompatibilityScore` is 0.0-1.0 (`validator/dashboard.go`, `prometheus/validator.go`), but the CUE kind schema and TS comments describe 0-100 — don't assume one scale carries across layers.

Adding a new datasource type requires touching: a package implementing `validator.DatasourceValidator` (`validator/types.go`) and optionally `cache.MetricsProvider` (`cache/provider.go`); both the `validators` map entry and `metricsCache.RegisterProvider` call in `pkg/registry/apps/dashvalidator/register.go`; the hardcoded "currently only 'prometheus' is supported" error string in `app.go`; and the MVP single-datasource gates in `dashboard.go` and `app.go:handleCheckRoute` if true multi-datasource support is intended.

`MetricsCache.RegisterProvider` (`cache/cache.go`) panics on duplicate registration and `prometheus.NewValidator` (`prometheus/validator.go`) panics on nil cache — these are deliberate startup-time wiring guards, not bugs to silence with defensive checks.
applies: Applies to the live hand-built /check route request/response path; does not apply to the DashboardCompatibilityScore CUE kind, which is currently dead code (GetKinds() returns empty).
